exampleMix.reason: Smash is necessary for the original special-move roles; Ocarina of Time is necessary for an actual example of auto-jump. Celeste contributes an intentional 2D ledge crossing in a separate genre.

01.focus: Launch against the ledge shows the cause of crossing. Then ask what happens when our own action moves us.

02.focus: Visible dash near a ledge. Compare a walk, stationary attack drift and full rush on a shared boundary.

03.focus: Retail combat establishes visible travel phases; the three named techniques are roles in the model, not identified as actions in the retail cut.

04.focus: Show hold, parallel movement and auto-jump together, then Link's native-speed stepping-stone jump.

05.focus: Fresh view of the same game rule, then retain three resolved ledge conditions and the intended-input takeaway.
